question: How many years do you have to get an attorney for medical malpractice?
answer_body: Two years from the date of the negligent conduct. If the care resulted in a death, two years from the date of death.

You generally have two years to file a medical-malpractice lawsuit.  The deadline usually runs from the date of the negligent act or, in some cases, when the related treatment or hospitalization ended.
